cost:
(define (cost key)
  (unless (and (string? key) (> (string-length key) 0))
    (error 'cost "key must be a non-empty string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))]
         [usd (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c cs])
                (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
                    (let ([p (hash-ref ps (string->symbol (hash-ref c 'model "")) #f)])
                      (if p (+ t (/ (* (hash-ref c 'tokens 0) p) 100000)) t))
                    t))])
    (/ (floor (+ (* usd 100) 1/2)) 100)))
record_usage:
(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (unless (and (string? key) (> (string-length key) 0))
    (error 'record_usage "key must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (and (string? model) (> (string-length model) 0))
    (error 'record_usage "model must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (and (real? tokens) (integer? tokens) (> tokens 0))
    (error 'record_usage "tokens must be a positive whole number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [qs (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))]
         [q (hash-ref qs (string->symbol key) #f)])
    (when (and q (> (+ (usage key) tokens) q))
      (error 'record_usage (format "key ~a would exceed its quota" key)))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append cs (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens))))))
  (usage key))
set_price:
(define (set_price model cents_per_1k_tokens)
  (unless (string? model)
    (error 'set_price "model must be a string"))
  (unless (and (real? cents_per_1k_tokens) (>= cents_per_1k_tokens 0)
               (not (infinite? cents_per_1k_tokens)) (not (nan? cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    (error 'set_price "price must be a non-negative number of cents per 1000 tokens"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'prices (hash-set ps (string->symbol model) cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    cents_per_1k_tokens))
set_quota:
(define (set_quota key tokens)
  (unless (and (string? key) (> (string-length key) 0))
    (error 'set_quota "key must be a non-empty string"))
  (unless (and (real? tokens) (integer? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'set_quota "quota must be a whole number of tokens, zero or more"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [qs (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))]
         [used (usage key)])
    (when (> used tokens)
      (error 'set_quota (format "key ~a already used ~a tokens, over quota" key used)))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'quotas (hash-set qs (string->symbol key) tokens)))
    tokens))
top_spender:
(define (top_spender)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [keys (sort (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (c) (hash-ref c 'key "")) cs)) string<?)])
    (if (null? keys)
        'null
        (let-values ([(b bc) (for/fold ([b 'null] [bc -1]) ([k keys])
                              (let ([c (cost k)])
                                (if (> c bc) (values k c) (values b bc))))])
          b))))
usage:
(define (usage key)
  (unless (and (string? key) (> (string-length key) 0))
    (error 'usage "key must be a non-empty string"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())])
    (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c cs])
      (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
          (+ t (hash-ref c 'tokens 0))
          t))))
